title: Guided tour
replayDesc: Walk through the dashboard basics again.

pages.title: The rail
pages.body: On the left: home in green, then your pages and pinned panels. One page per room or per floor, whatever fits.

edit.title: Edit mode
edit.body: The pencil opens the whole page for editing. Nothing moves while it is off.

add.title: Add a widget
add.body: Open the catalog and pick a card — light, camera, sensor, thermostat… — then the entity it controls.

addPage.title: A new page
addPage.body: Add a page to split your dashboard by room or floor. Each page has its own panels.

save.title: Done
save.body: “Done” saves and leaves edit mode. The cross discards your changes; Ctrl+Z undoes one step at a time.

settings.title: The launcher
settings.body: The blue button opens the launcher: favourite pages, panels, settings, screensaver, guided tour.

widgetsAdd.title: The catalog
widgetsAdd.body: Widgets are grouped by category. Pick one, then the Home Assistant entity it should control. A panel's “+” drops it right there.

widgetsResize.title: Arranging tiles
widgetsResize.body: In edit mode, drag a tile from one panel to another — finger or mouse — and resize it from its corner. One layout for every screen: on a phone, panels stack.

widgetsSave.title: Keep your work
widgetsSave.body: Save once the layout suits you. The dashboard is stored on the server, so every device sees it.

panelsCreate.title: Custom panels
panelsCreate.body: In the launcher, “Custom panels” builds a sheet from blocks: rows of covers, action buttons, section titles.

panelsDock.title: Pin them to the rail
panelsDock.body: In edit mode, a panel's pin in the launcher adds it to the rail: it opens in one tap.

appearanceOpen.title: Settings
appearanceOpen.body: In the launcher: dark or light theme, automatic day/night switch, sounds, regional formats, language.

appearanceWallpanel.title: Screensaver
appearanceWallpanel.body: Also in the launcher: the wall-tablet screensaver — large clock or photo frame, with your widgets on top.

planModel.title: The house
planModel.body: Turn it with a finger, pinch to zoom. Tap a room: the camera flies to it, and Escape brings back the whole house.

planChips.title: The chips
planChips.body: Each shows the state of its entity. A tap turns the lamp on or opens its sheet, a long press always opens the sheet.

planButtons.title: The views
planButtons.body: The shield shows what was left open — and arms the alarm —, the thermometer the temperature of the rooms; the clock replays the last 24 hours, the arrow centres the house again.

planSettings.title: The settings
planSettings.body: Four tabs: the model and its home view, the ambiance — sky, weather, lamp glow —, the openings to link, and the elements: lamps, rooms, cables.

planTools.title: The tools
planTools.body: A tool, then a click on the model: place a chip, link or draw a door, trace a room on the floor or an energy cable.

planSave.title: Save
planSave.body: Nothing is kept without “Save”, and every gesture undoes with Ctrl+Z.

panelButtons.title: Panels
panelButtons.body: Each page arranges its tiles in panels. ⚙ sets up a panel — title, width, place below the previous one — and ✎ edits only that panel.
